The Property Guardian Program (PGP) is a tool for property and
facility managers who choose to be proactive rather than reactive
when it comes to business disruption or interruption from water,
fire or storm damage or the discovery of mold or other biohazards.
The PGP is designed to offer a variety of levels of service and
commitment, allowing each property or facility manager to “curate”
or customize a program that works best for them and the facilities
they are responsible for.
The PGP establishes a relationship between the property or facility
manager and a restoration contractor who will function as a
Disaster Preparedness Advisor and provide mitigation and
restoration services according to the specifics of the PGP.
The Property Guardian Program is ideal for property managers,
facility managers, property owners, risk managers and other
responsible parties that not only see the value in being proactive
but also:

In the event of water, fire, storm or other damage requiring emergency services it is important to obtain mitigation
services as quickly as possible in order to reduce severity of damage, control costs and return to normal operations
as quickly as possible.
This pre-authorization acknowledges that GCPRO Restoration has been thoroughly vetted and is approved to
provide emergency services work in the event of water, fire or storm damage to the property listed below or
properties listed as part of this document.

With This Pre-Authorization:
We Will Create a Plan for When Disaster Strikes
•
We will create an Emergency Response Program (ERP) for the properties listed.
•
Having specific disaster planning information about your property on file at our office allows us to respond faster
and more effectively due to our prior knowledge of your facility and the information we have on hand regarding
your building(s), personnel, operations, etc.
•
When you have an emergency this plan will inform you as to:
•
What to Do
•
Who to Call
•
What to Expect
•
Your ERP will be on file online for 24/7 access by our team and your team.
•
Check with your insurance agent as your ERP may even help you obtain discounts on your General Liability
insurance.
You Will Receive Priority Service
•
Under normal conditions, when an emergency occurs, we will respond to initial notification of the emergency
within 15 minutes and will arrive on-site within 2 hours barring extenuating circumstances such as traffic, etc.
•
During a severe, area-wide weather event, our “next available crew” service pledge means that we will provide
priority response to all ERP (Preferred) clients with the next available crew before any other non-ERP service
requests are fulfilled.

We Will Begin Emergency Services Immediately without  Requiring a Deposit
•
We will respond, execute a service agreement and begin emergency services immediately without an initial deposit
being required. This will allow us to respond immediately to losses after hours or on weekends without delay.
We Will Mitigate and Prevent Further Damage
•
We will mitigate the loss including board-up and tarping, water extraction, structural drying, providing restorative
cleaning as well as other appropriate actions to stabilize the situation and prevent further damage.
•
To accomplish this we will provide a variety of resources including labor, equipment, materials, tools and other
necessary items as needed.
•
We will supply personnel trained in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and
the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) standards.
•
We will have appropriate commercial general liability, pollution liability and workman’s compensation insurance
coverage.
•
Our company and our employees will keep all information pertaining to your operations and the emergency
situation confidential, unless otherwise required by law or to protect life, health or safety.
During a Loss We Become Your “Claims Administrator”
•
We will provide transparency through regular updates so that any third party can see what the source of the loss
was and what steps are being taken to restore it such as Regional Managers, distant property owners and Claims
Adjusters. This allows you to stay updated on the progress of restoration without being inconvenienced and
creates a permanent record of proper restoration.
•
As your “Claims Administrator” we will help you manage the process and provide the highest levels of
communication.
•
Our “Mitigation Focused, Full Service” approach will control costs and return you to normal operations faster.
•
Our comprehensive documentation and working to the Standard of Care will help assure you that the work was
done correctly and protect you from liability.
Post-Loss Debriefing
•
We will offer a thorough debriefing after any emergency to review what happened and why, examine whether
additional preventive measures should be implemented as well as review the restoration in terms of process,
equipment utilized, costs, documentation and other details.
Certificate of Professional Restoration
•
We will provide a Certificate of Professional Restoration that documents the loss was properly restored according
to the Standard of Care by a licensed, certified and professional restoration contractor.
•
This protects the property’s value, protects against “sick building” issues (real or imagined), enhances tenant
retention and protects against downstream liability.
